headline: Estrada's leadoff homer in the 10th beats Marlins
recap: Johnny Estrada led off the bottom of the 10th with a home run, none out, to give the Phillies a 5-4 win over the Florida Marlins. It capped a wild finish: Travis Lee tied the game with a two-out solo homer in the bottom of the ninth after the Marlins had taken a 4-2 lead on back-to-back home runs by Preston Wilson and Mike Lowell in the top of the eighth.

Brandon Duckworth started for Philadelphia and allowed two runs over 6.2 innings with three strikeouts and two walks. Ryan Dempster started for Florida and allowed three runs over six innings, also with three strikeouts and two walks.

Ricky Bottalico surrendered both eighth-inning home runs out of the Phillies bullpen and was charged with the blown save. Jose Mesa worked a scoreless top of the 10th to pick up the win, and Juan Acevedo took the loss after allowing Estrada's homer to the first batter he faced. Lee's two home runs, in the fourth inning and the tying blast in the ninth, were his 17th and 18th of the season.
